verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers developer surfaces: the Apps SDK, REST and Connect APIs, and an MCP server that lets external AI assistants generate or edit designs. None of it documents built-in editor AI for image generation, background removal, content-aware fill or copy suggestions. The single mention of 'Canva AI' only describes pasting links in to add context, which is an adjacent feature rather than evidence of these asset tools.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor
